design.focus: Display title, then the serif accent; agenda chips become the progress rail. No fiction badge: the claim is general, with no invented figures.

cues.concept: A transfer is a movement of an existing quantity.
cues.metaphor: A heavy display headline that rises into place.
cues.behavior: The title words rise on their spoken cues.
cues.camera: Locked wide frame on R1 with a slow push-in.
cues.next: The serif accent qualifies the claim.
risks: Display title must clear the kicker above it.
The kicker names a demonstration; the fiction badge stays off until invented figures appear.

cues.concept: Movement does not destroy the quantity.
cues.metaphor: A serif-italic accent line in the accent colour, underlined by hand.
cues.behavior: The accent resolves from blur, then an underline draws under the last word.
cues.next: The agenda turns the promise into three steps.
risks: Underline must not touch the agenda chips.

cues.text: To see why, we will find the total, follow the quantity, and check the balance.
cues.concept: The lesson has three checkable steps.
cues.metaphor: Agenda chips that later persist as a progress rail.
cues.behavior: Each chip pops on its spoken verb.
cues.camera: Hold; the opener lifts away at the scene end.
cues.next: The first step, the total, becomes a full-screen claim.
cues.silentMeaning: There are three steps in order.
risks: Chips must fit the safe zone on one row.

design.focus: Ghost sentence fills as spoken; the signal highlighter marks 150, which then travels into the total badge. The fiction badge comes on with the invented figures.

cues.text: Two accounts share one fixed total of 150 units.
cues.concept: Two balances contribute to one conserved total.
cues.metaphor: A ghosted sentence that fills in as it is spoken.
cues.behavior: Words fill on their cues; the signal highlighter sweeps under 150 as it is said; the fiction badge fades in.
cues.next: The highlighted number is carried into the next scene.
risks: Highlighter must contain its word.

cues.concept: The total is the reference for everything that follows.
cues.metaphor: The emphasised number physically travels to its new home.
cues.behavior: The sentence fades while 150 flies to the badge; the badge pops when it lands.
cues.camera: Slight push-in releases as the badge lands.
cues.next: The badge stays on screen above the accounts.
risks: The carried number must not cross remaining sentence words.

design.transitionIn: hero carry into the total badge
design.focus: The state code is taught where each state first appears (held, then in transit). B dims while the quantity leaves A; a reframing push (fitCamera) frames the route and a ledger readout while the units travel, after the equation fades (beforePush) and the balance figures fade (S.onScreen); the release comes before the landing, and focus hands to B before A dims.

cues.text: Account A holds 100 units, and Account B holds 50.
cues.concept: The starting balances.
cues.metaphor: Two cards holding measured vessels; each names its account over its balance.
cues.behavior: Each card pops on its spoken name; its balance counts up through round steps while its figure is said (spoken count) and the vessel fills with it; the state key names the held state.
cues.camera: Hold on the badge and both accounts.
cues.next: A route draws between the vessels.
cues.silentMeaning: A holds more than B; together they make the badge.
risks: "holds" is spoken twice, so each count cue names its occurrence.
A balance never shows a figure before it is said.

cues.text: Now ten units leave Account A.
cues.concept: A transfer begins at its origin.
cues.metaphor: A hatched token, the in-transit state, rises out of A while A drains.
cues.behavior: The route draws and the equation appears; the hatched token rises out of A and the state key adds In transit; A steps to 90 as the transit term opens, so the line always adds up.
risks: Token crossing the A card is intentional and documented.
The token figure stays above the vessel rims.

cues.text: While they travel, they are still counted: ten in transit.
cues.concept: An in-flight quantity remains part of the total.
cues.metaphor: A ledger of where every unit is: held, in transit, held.
cues.behavior: The equation fades before the push; the camera pushes in on the route and the ledger; rows land on "still" and "counted", and 10 appears on the second "ten" under the signal highlighter, which retracts on "Then".
cues.camera: Reframing push: fitCamera on the route and ledger (zoom 1.3), held while the units travel.
cues.silentMeaning: The ten is still counted while moving.
risks: "ten" is spoken twice; the figure cues the second.
Balance figures and the equation fade before the push would carry them to the frame edge.

cues.text: Then they arrive in Account B, and the total never changed.
cues.concept: Arrival completes the transfer and the total survives it.
cues.metaphor: The token sinks into B and a ring confirms the landing; the badge is circled.
cues.behavior: The ledger leaves and the camera releases before the landing; B fills and steps to 60 as the transit term closes; the badge is circled and annotated.
cues.camera: Release the push back to the wide frame before the units land.
cues.silentMeaning: B gained what A lost; the total did not move.
risks: Token crossing the B card is intentional and documented.
The ledger is gone before arrival, so it is not read as the state after it.

cues.concept: The invariant is restated as a number.
cues.metaphor: The circled badge and its note hold on screen.
cues.behavior: No new motion: the annotation is given reading time.
cues.camera: Hold the wide frame, then pan at the scene end.
cues.next: The camera pans to a before-and-after comparison.
risks: The pan must not start before the note is readable.

design.transitionIn: camera pan R1 -> R2 with motion blur
design.focus: The changed column dims when the total is named; the conserved column is marked in the good colour.

cues.concept: Comparing states isolates what changed.
cues.metaphor: Two columns separated by a drawn divider.
cues.behavior: The divider draws as the scene opens.
cues.camera: Arrive on R2 after the pan.
risks: Headings must clear the title.

cues.text: The balances changed: A fell to 90, and B rose to 60.
cues.concept: Both balances changed by the same amount in opposite directions.
cues.metaphor: Old values are struck in ink (replaced, not wrong); new values pop as chips.
cues.behavior: Each row appears on its spoken verb; old values are struck before new values pop.
cues.silentMeaning: A went down and B went up.
risks: Strikes and arrows are unregistered strokes; keep them off numerals.

cues.concept: The total is unchanged.
cues.metaphor: The conserved column receives a drawn check mark.
cues.behavior: The total row appears and the changed column dims.
cues.camera: Hold; focus moves by contrast, not camera.
risks: Dimmed column must stay legible.

cues.text: Check the total before you trust the movement.
cues.concept: A practical habit for reading transfers.
cues.metaphor: A serif takeaway line.
cues.behavior: The takeaway resolves from blur word by word.
cues.camera: Hold, then pan to the series.
cues.next: Repeated transfers extend the same idea over time.
risks: Takeaway must stay above the caption band.

design.transitionIn: camera pan R2 -> R3 with motion blur
design.focus: Series dim when the flat total is named; A and B keep their own line colours.

cues.concept: The same rule holds across many transfers.
cues.metaphor: A time axis for repeated transfers.
cues.behavior: The axis draws and period labels fade in.
cues.camera: Arrive on R3 after the pan.
risks: Labels must not collide with the axis line.

cues.text: Four transfers later, the balances have swung up and down, but the total line stays flat at 150.
cues.concept: Balances vary while the total is invariant.
cues.metaphor: Two swinging series and one flat accent line.
cues.behavior: Series trace with dots; the total line lands last; series dim and a note names the contrast.
cues.next: An iris opens from the end of the total line into the method.
cues.silentMeaning: Balances move; the total does not.
risks: End chips must not overlap each other at the last period.

design.transitionIn: two-phase accent iris from the total line
design.focus: Completed steps settle to half strength; the token marks the active step. The fiction badge is off: the method is general, so its details carry no invented figures.

cues.concept: The lesson turns into a reusable procedure.
cues.metaphor: A rail with three stations.
cues.behavior: The title rises and the rail draws.
risks: Title must clear the rail.
The fiction badge has faded out before the method is read.

cues.text: Read any transfer in three steps.
cues.concept: The procedure has three steps.
cues.metaphor: A serif accent names the count.
cues.behavior: The accent resolves from blur.
risks: Accent must not touch the first step.

cues.concept: Step one: identify the conserved total.
cues.metaphor: The token appears at step one.
cues.behavior: Step one activates on its verb.
risks: Token must not cover step text.

cues.concept: Step two: track what is in transit.
cues.metaphor: The token travels down the rail.
cues.behavior: The token travels and step two activates.
cues.next: The token moves to the last step.
risks: Same as above.

cues.concept: Step three: verify the sum.
cues.metaphor: The token lands on the last step; earlier steps are ticked.
cues.behavior: Step three activates; earlier steps settle.
cues.camera: Hold, then wipe to the check.
risks: Mono details must remain readable; all three steps stay within the word budget.

design.transitionIn: slanted wipe to the night background
design.focus: Mira, a cast preset, asks the question beside a picture of the situation: both balances held, the 25 that would move hatched. Wrong options dim under a wrong-red strike; the right option takes the signal highlighter; tags then say what each option is. The fiction badge is back on for the practice panel.

cues.concept: The viewer applies the rule.
cues.metaphor: A different mode: the night background.
cues.behavior: The kicker fades in.
risks: Kicker must clear the prompt.
The fiction badge returns with the practice panel.

cues.text: Mira asks: if 25 units move from B to A, what is the total?
cues.concept: A new transfer in the opposite direction, asked by a recurring person.
cues.metaphor: A ghosted prompt over a picture: the clerk asks beside two lanes and a hatched quantity about to move.
cues.behavior: Mira appears as she is named and speaks while the prompt fills; the lanes draw; "Moves: 25" lands on "25" and the arrow on "move"; options pop after the prompt.
risks: The picture shows the question, never the answer.
Prompt, picture and options stay within the 24-word budget.

cues.concept: Give the viewer time to answer.
cues.metaphor: Nothing new appears; the options wait.
cues.behavior: Hold the options without decoration.
risks: Do not fill the pause with motion.

cues.concept: The answer: the total is unchanged.
cues.metaphor: The correct option takes the signal highlighter while the others are struck in the wrong red.
cues.behavior: The right option takes the signal highlighter (its type turns ink under it); wrong options dim under a wrong-red strike; the prompt dims, then tags say what each option is.
risks: Strikes must stay inside their chips.
Tags wait until the prompt has dimmed, so the frame stays within the word budget.

cues.text: Moving units changes balances, not the total.
cues.concept: The general rule.
cues.metaphor: A serif reason line.
cues.behavior: The reason resolves from blur on its words.
risks: Reason must stay above the caption band.
